caption: The drawing depicts a two-piece glass object consisting of a lid and a bowl on a pedestal base. The lid, which is positioned above the bowl as if it has been lifted off, is circular with a central finial in the form of a seated human figure dressed in draped clothing and a headdress or elaborate hairstyle. The bowl beneath has a broad, shallow form with flared sides and is decorated with etched or engraved imagery, including a landscape featuring trees, mountains, and a central figure. The bowl sits on a short stem with a knobbed accent and a wide, circular base adorned with radial lines. The objects are rendered with fine lines and subtle shading in shades of light brown and gray, giving a transparent effect that suggests they are made of glass. The overall composition is vertically aligned with careful attention to the spacing and proportions of the separated lid and bowl.
title: Westward Ho Compote
